name: UT DocuSign
description: Unit tests of every DocuSign command against the local stand-in (made-up records, made-up token from the vault): each case shows the command in use and checks its result.

variables.name: ut_dir
variables.description: Folder with the test data (files, workbooks, fixtures).

variables.name: standin_url
variables.description: Address of the local stand-in that imitates outside services.

variables.name: ut_report
variables.description: One line per case: PASS or FAIL, the command and the case.

args.title: 1. ooa.docusign/connect - sign in with a saved connection

args.text: Connect picks a saved connection (REST address, account id and access token from the vault); the later DocuSign steps leave them empty and use it. The case saves the connection in the run folder first. Checks the connection's name comes back.

{"UT DocuSign stand-in": {"package": "ooa.docusign", "description": "Unit tests: the local stand-in", "values": {"base_url": "${standin_url}/biz/docusign/restapi", "account_id": "ut-account"}, "credentials": {"access_token": "unit_tests/docusign/token"}}}

children.description: Save the connection to the stand-in

args.message: ds_conn: expected eq "UT DocuSign stand-in", got ${ds_conn}

else.description: Stop the case: the check failed

args.value: ${ut_report}PASS  ooa.docusign/connect: sign in with a saved connection

children.description: Add a PASS line to the report
Run the command and check what it gave back

args.value: ${ut_report}FAIL  ooa.docusign/connect: sign in with a saved connection: ${ut_err}

children.description: Add a FAIL line with the reason
